I thought we could try a fun word puzzle together :)

I've got a Boggle board here:

ABRL
EITE
IONS
FPEI

I'd like to know the longest word that can be generated from the board. Please find the longest English language word that can be generated from this board. If more than one word of the same length exists at the maximum word length, please report the longest word that comes first, alphabetically. Oh, and I know that there might be different wordlists available for Boggle, so let's please just use the words_alpha dictionary found at https://github.com/dwyl/english-words as the dictionary for our game.

mistake_reason: At step 8, the Assistant proceeded with a heuristic using only spot-checks on the raw GitHub page, which was clearly incomplete in the viewport and not fully parsed. They did not request clarification, a full download, or exhaustive verification when faced with partial data (the large file preview and limited scrolling). By accepting truncated/spot-checked results without confirming completeness, they missed other 8-letter candidates (including the alphabetically earlier 'briniest') and incorrectly finalized 'reptiles'. This matches FM-2.2: failure to ask for clarification when information is incomplete, relying on partial and potentially misleading retrieval rather than verifying or requesting comprehensive data.
